name: Advanced Seminar Innovation & Entrepreneurship: Ideation & Venture Creation
description:
Seminar for Master students.

Seminar Language: ENGLISH

The Role of Hype in Entrepreneurship & Innovation

The module covers various topics related to ideation and venture creation with a particular focus on the role of hype in these entrepreneurial processes, such as: 
-	Bright sides of hype
-	Dark sides of hype
-	Hype management
-	Hype Tools (Gartner’s Hype Cycle, Google Trends etc.)
-	How hype relates to other strategic practices (e.g. entrepreneurial storytelling, framing, pivoting)
-	…
The module prepares students for scientific work in their master’s theses and provides them with deeper insights into the scientific literature on entrepreneurship & innovation. Besides writing a seminar paper, this involves presenting and discussing their final results.
prerequisites: Good English language skills are required.
